Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or titration schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

ACE inhibitor used in selected paediatric hypertension and heart-failure pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mg/kg dose or renal monitoring interval; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Active vitamin D analogue used in selected hypocalcaemia and renal-bone pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a microgram dose or calcium-monitoring interval; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Catecholamine used in selected paediatric shock pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a mcg/kg/min infusion rate or titration algorithm; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.

Somatostatin analogue used in selected paediatric secretory-diarrhoea and endocrine pathways — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose or infusion schedule; confirm against current SA Paediatric STG/EML and the labelled product.
